title: Syrian Juicy Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic recipe for chicken kebabs with a smoky twist inspired by Syrian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Syrian kebab spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at Middle Eastern stores or online

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika
ingredients.notes: Adds a smoky flavor to the kebabs

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the kebabs during grilling

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Syrian kebab spice blend, smoked paprika, lemon juice, and 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken, garlic, and onion onto skewers.
Brush the kebabs with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, salad, or pita bread.
